reauth_confirm.description: Your session expired or the password changed. Enter your credentials again.

error.no_installations: No supply points found for this account

waf_blocked.title: Login blocked by Enel's WAF
waf_blocked.description: The "Enel SP Auth" add-on could not complete the login — the Enel portal is blocking automated access. This is not a username/password issue; the integration will keep retrying automatically on the next cycles.

addon_unavailable.title: "Enel SP Auth" add-on unavailable
addon_unavailable.description: Install and start the "Enel SP Auth" add-on from the Supervisor add-on store so the integration can log in.
